Curriculum and Courses
Master of Philosophy (MPhil) in Nano Science and Technology
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Nano Science and Technology
The goal of the MPhil in Nano Science and Technology program is to train postgraduate students to conduct independent research in nano science and technology. The goal of the PhD in Nano Science and Technology program is to train postgraduate students in carrying out original research in nano science and technology, and to cultivate independent and innovative thinking.
Students are expected to undertake course work, attend seminars, conduct thesis research, etc. in order to fulfil the degree requirement. For details of the currculum and courses offered by Nano Science and Technology Program, please refer to the following link :
http://prog-crs.ust.hk/pgcourse
